data.name: Army Air Corps
data.detailed_description:
The Battle for the Pacific Skies Begins. 

We are proud to present Army Air Corps, a thrilling vertical shoot 'em up game that puts you at the stick of the famous P-38 fighter. Your mission: advance through enemy territory, defeat powerful air units, and return safely back to the carrier. 

Fast paced action and simple responsive controls make Army Air Corps easy to learn and exciting to master. Destroy enemy formations, avoid incoming fire, and use your limited loop-de-loop maneuver to escape danger at critical moments.

  • Complete 16 Missions Across the Pacific Theater
    Battle waves of enemy fighters and bombers as you advance closer and closer to the land of the Rising Sun. Each mission more challenging than the last. 

  • Special Loop Maneuver
    When enemy fire gets too heavy, perform a spectacular mid-air loop de loop to temporarily dodge the barrage of bullets.

  • Power Ups!
    Shoot down an entire bi-plane squadron to earn an extra life, a powerful Quad Gun (doubling your fire power), or even resurrect your downed co-op comrade.

  • Local Coop Play
    Let your friends join you as a wingman in the famous British Mosquito. True esprit de Air Corps!

  • 3D Graphics!
    Army Air Corps breaks from the 2D arcade into more realism with real 3D models instead of 2D sprites.

Prepare for take off, pilot. The skies await!

data.short_description: A top‑down arcade shooter with WWII‑inspired aircraft. Fight Solo or 2‑player Co‑op with your friends. Shoot through waves of enemy planes, dodge bullets, and master each Pacific theatre mission. Make it back safe to the carrier!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
